mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
Design and Vision
Design, document, and balance game mechanics, progression systems, and virtual economies.
Write and maintain clear, structured Game Design Documents (GDD) to serve as a reference for technical and artistic teams.
Ensure game content aligns with the core pillars of the project and the overall Game Loop.
Coordination and Alignment
Collaborate daily with programmers and artists to ensure the faithful implementation of designed mechanics.
Identify "day-to-day" design issues (unclear mechanics, logic bugs, pacing issues) and propose rapid solutions.
Alert production regarding the complexity of certain features that could affect the project’s scope or delivery timeline.
Iteration and Quality
Prototype new ideas within Unity to quickly test "fun factor" and accessibility.
Facilitate and participate in playtest sessions to observe player behavior and adjust the design accordingly.
Analyze data and community feedback (Discord, surveys) to identify friction points and improve the overall experience.
Launch Support and Community
Collaborate with the marketing team to prepare launch materials (tutorials, feature breakdowns).
Monitor community feedback at launch to prioritize gameplay adjustments and necessary balancing.

Hands-on experience with the Unity engine.
Technical Skills:
Excellent mastery of design principles (mechanics, systems, economy, UX).
Ability to write high-quality technical and creative documentation.
Understanding of VR market and multiplayer. A familiarity with free-to-play VR market
Professional Skills:
Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in an iterative environment.
Sensitivity to emerging trends in gaming and social spaces.
